title: Ceyo Nigeria | Autonomous 24/7 Personal AI Agents
description: Supercharge your business in Nigeria with autonomous AI agents. 24/7 cloud computers, web automation, coding, and Telegram bots that never drop offline.
h1: Run Your Nigerian Business Nonstop with Autonomous AI
sub: Deploy dedicated cloud bots that research, code, and automate your workflows around the clock—even when your phone is turned off.
audience: Founders in Yaba, digital agencies, importers, e-commerce merchants, and freelance developers navigating fast-moving Nigerian and global markets.
manifesto: When network fluctuations and traffic on the Third Mainland Bridge slow your day down, Ceyo keeps working. Your autonomous cloud agents manage operations, research markets, and write code uninterrupted, twenty-four hours a day.

uses.d: Your agent browses online marketplaces and distributor catalogs, scrapes live inventory rates, and updates Google Sheets continuously.
An autonomous developer writes, tests, and deploys full-stack prototypes inside its cloud sandbox without draining your laptop battery.
Monitor international supplier directories and currency changes around the clock, delivering synthesis reports straight to Telegram.
Sync order leads from incoming emails and web forms directly into Notion or your sales CRM through 1,000+ app integrations.
Assign overnight research on regulatory changes or energy sector updates and wake up to structured, long-memory briefings.
Put specialized research, copy, and analytics bots into a single Telegram group to manage client deliverables as a team.

steps.d: Select Plus, Pro, or Ultra to activate your 3-day free trial.
Define custom tasks, connect apps like Gmail and Slack, or launch a Telegram bot.
Your bots browse, code, and work independently in their isolated cloud environments.

chapters.d: While navigating morning traffic in Lagos, your voice agent calls your phone with a briefing of overnight leads. It has already organized new inquiries in Google Sheets.
Your browser bot crawls supply sites and compares equipment pricing across international vendors. It compiles key data points into a shared document without manual oversight.
Your coding agent drafts Python scripts, runs automated tests in its isolated cloud computer, and updates your repository. It alerts your team on Slack once builds pass.
Even when your local power cuts out and your phone is off, your cloud bots continue running scheduled data crawls. Tomorrow's work is ready before dawn.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Plans are Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day. A card is linked upon signup and only charged when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Does Ceyo keep working if my phone loses power or internet?
faq.a: Yes, every bot operates on its own dedicated cloud computer independent of your local device. Even if your phone is off or your connection drops, your agents continue browsing, coding, and scheduling tasks 24/7.

faq.q: Can I use Ceyo directly via Telegram?
faq.a: Absolutely. You can connect your bots directly to personal Telegram accounts or add multiple specialized bots to Telegram group chats so they collaborate together as a team.

faq.q: What languages can Ceyo understand and communicate in?
faq.a: Ceyo supports natural communication in English, Nigerian Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, and hundreds of other world languages for research, translation, and conversation.

faq.q: What apps can my agents connect with?
faq.a: Ceyo integrates with over 1,000 cloud tools, including Google Sheets, Gmail, Slack, Notion, calendars, and major CRMs, letting your bots automate real-world business workflows.
